subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback continue to fail closed whenever microphone state is unknown, rather than preserving the prior non-muted-ready behavior?
rationale: This is a deliberate upgrade-visible policy change, not merely a mechanical bug fix; source tests establish the intended behavior but do not establish that existing browser integrations reliably expose microphone state.

options.title: Keep explicit-unmuted readiness
options.body: Retain the fail-closed policy after adding the recovery repair and live evidence that normal signed-in Meet sessions expose the required state.

options.title: Preserve unknown-state compatibility
options.body: Allow unknown microphone state as before and keep only explicit muted or manual-action states blocked.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit-unmuted readiness
recommendation.body: Retain the fail-closed policy after adding the recovery repair and live evidence that normal signed-in Meet sessions expose the required state.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared meeting runtime and authored the policy and recovery changes under review.
